target: DVWA Medium PHP sources in duel/dvwa_source, plus our SQLi patch as a negative control
method: Manual source review on 2026-11-06 before the new PHP tool runs. Prior vuln-web results and instructor fixtures were known; this new reference is based on DVWA PHP code, not outputs of the tools being scored. AI-assisted review; group members must review before submission.

findings.note: mysqli_real_escape_string escapes quoted-string syntax, but ID enters an unquoted numeric expression. OR/comment/boolean variants expand row selection. MySQL and SQLite branches both build query text with input.
str_replace removes exactly lowercase <script>. Mixed-case script markup survives and name enters an HTML pre element without output encoding.
The filter removes && and semicolon, but pipe and newline survive in target. target concatenates into shell_exec(ping ...), permitting whoami output.

true_negatives.note: Our patch uses a constant statement and mysqli_stmt_bind_param, then HTML-encodes ID and names. Focused injection control, not a claim about CSRF or the entire app.

not_present.note: These snippets provide no role/ownership policy to establish a distinct violation. DVWA authentication is outside the snippets; no observed A01 finding does not prove the whole app has none.

scoring: One key per class and file; duplicate database branches count once. Unexpected findings need source review, not silent ground-truth relabeling.
